stem.text: Compound X is the oxide of a Period 3 element. Compound X reacts with water to give an acidic solution.

A solution is prepared by reacting $0.100\ \text{g}$ of compound X with an excess of water. This solution is neutralised by exactly $25.0\ \text{cm}^{3}$ of $0.100\ \text{mol dm}^{-3}$ sodium hydroxide solution.
What could be the identity of compound X?
